title: Bottle Green Embroidered Kurti with Side Tie-Up
description:
Harita means “green” – a deep, fresh green with fine white embroidery.

A deep bottle green kurti in light georgette, knee length with a round neck. A breezy straight kurti with delicate white thread embroidery scattered all over. The lined bodice sits above a sheer lower panel, with side tie-up cords and tassels that let you adjust the fit, and a keyhole back with a button closure.

Style it with jeans for college or office, or with palazzos for festive days. Made in Jaipur.
care: Gentle hand wash or dry clean.
